note: Primary release material for fixes tied to a flaw chain that could allow an unauthenticated LDAP client to create attacker-controlled Kerberos credentials and reach administrative privilege.

title: BigBear 2.0 phishing campaign hijacks Microsoft 365 sessions after MFA
note: CloudSEK’s reporting details a phishing-as-a-service operation that captured Microsoft 365 session cookies after MFA, including 4,148 cookies and 1,032 passwords tied to hundreds of targets.

title: Veradigm Inc. Form 8-K: Third-party vendor cybersecurity incident
note: Veradigm’s filing states that an unauthorized party obtained vendor credentials and used them against a limited API to download patient data, providing a clear service-credential abuse case.

title: GTIG AI Threat Tracker: From Prompting to Autonomy – The Evolution of Adversarial AI
note: GTIG reports adversaries compromising cloud resources and using agent-enabled workflows to build and execute mass credential-harvesting campaigns, while targeting API credentials and AI infrastructure.

title: FAQ for Microsoft-provided SMS and voice retirement - Microsoft Entra ID
note: Microsoft's rollout moves Entra tenants from Microsoft-managed SMS and voice toward passkeys, with important registration, opt-out, telecom-provider, and SSPR implications for identity teams.

title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
note: CloudSEK researchers found an Evilginx-based phishing service that intercepted Microsoft 365 credentials, MFA completions, and session cookies, with 258 organizations experiencing completed MFA-bypass compromises.

title: Tracking BigBear 2.0 Evilginx2 Phishing Campaign
note: The investigation exposes a Microsoft 365 phishing-as-a-service operation that captured thousands of credentials and session cookies, disabled WebAuthn in the browser, and replayed authenticated sessions after MFA.

title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
note: CloudSEK evidence shows a phishing-as-a-service operation using AiTM proxies to capture credentials and authenticated session cookies from more than 258 organizations.

title: Notification of Data Security Incident
note: Primary disclosure from an identity-verification provider concerning unauthorized access to cloud-stored identity information, including government-ID numbers.

title: Dropbox accounts breached through Lenovo email verification flaw
note: Security reporting on an identity-linking failure where fraudulent Lenovo IDs could be trusted into existing Dropbox accounts without the victim's Dropbox password.

title: Notice of Vote for Proposed OpenID Connect Ephemeral Subject Identifier 1.0 Final Specification
note: The proposed ephemeral subject identifier specification is a meaningful federation change for reducing persistent cross-party correlation and improving identity privacy in OpenID Connect deployments.

title: Agentic security: Detection and response at machine speed
note: AWS outlines an identity-centered detection and response model for autonomous agents that authenticate for users, execute multistep workflows, and require machine-speed containment.

note: Auth0’s early-access implementation of Cross App Access, Enterprise-Managed Authorization, and ID-JAG shows how enterprise IdPs can govern app-to-app and agent-to-tool authorization with short-lived exchanged tokens.

title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Identity now offers a managed consent portal
note: The managed consent portal removes custom OAuth callback and session-binding infrastructure for agents connecting to third-party services such as GitHub, Salesforce, and Slack.

title: Update on Security at METR
note: Primary incident disclosure covering a fail-open authentication bug, API-key theft, SSH persistence and a separate campaign involving credential stuffing and OAuth token-grant attempts.

title: Authorization in MCP 2026-07-28: Clarifying trust relationships for agentic systems
note: Architecture-focused treatment of trust relationships among users, hosts, agents, MCP servers, authorization servers and downstream resources; older, but durable enough to retain as a reference.

title: Public Review Period for Proposed OpenID Connect Ephemeral Subject Identifier 1.0 Final Specification
note: The proposed OIDC Ephemeral Subject Identifier entered its final-specification voting period on September 16, making its privacy and correlation implications newly actionable for federation architects.

title: Microsoft Entra ID security updates: Passkeys are the default authentication method in Entra ID
note: The September 18 milestone makes this newly operationally relevant: Microsoft is publishing provider and commercial details as Entra shifts users from SMS and voice toward passkeys.
